meta.description: Validation rules for PVE custom format types, extracted from Proxmox Perl source
notes: Format names ending in -list are handled automatically by PVE::JSONSchema — the input is split by commas and each element is validated against the base format.
Format names ending in -opt are also handled automatically — they accept empty string in addition to the base format.
Some formats like pve-fw-protocol-spec and pve-fw-sport-spec depend on system files (/etc/protocols, /etc/services) making them host-dependent.
The pve-storage-content enum varies by storage plugin type.

mac-addr.description: Unicast MAC address (second nibble must be even)

ipv6.pattern_note: Full RFC-compliant IPv6 regex from PVE::Tools — too complex for a single pattern string, use dedicated validator

email-opt.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

disk-size.accepts: Integer with optional size suffix: K, KiB, M, MiB, G, GiB, T, TiB
disk-size.description: Disk size with optional unit suffix

pve-output-format.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

storage-pair.accepts: source:target mapping, '1' for identity, or default target

bridge-pair.accepts: source:target mapping, '1' for identity, or default target

apitoken.description: Full PVE API token including secret

pve-priv.description: PVE privilege name (case-sensitive, validated by hash lookup). VM.Monitor was removed in PVE 9.0.

pve-userid.pattern_note: username@realm format, validated by verify_username in AccessControl.pm

pve-groupid.pattern_note: Validated by verify_groupname — alphanumeric with hyphens/underscores

pve-storage-content.note: Exact set depends on storage plugin type; these are the superset across all plugins

prune-backups.constraint: keep-all cannot be combined with other keep-* options

pve-cpuset.accepts: Comma-separated CPU IDs and ranges, e.g. '0,5,8-11'

pve-qm-bootdev.accepts: Valid drive names (ide*, scsi*, sata*, virtio*), net*, usb*, hostpci* — rejects efidisk, tpmstate

pve-qm-ide.note: Composite format: drivedesc_base + model_fmt + ssd_fmt + wwn_fmt. See Drive.pm for full property list.
pve-qm-ide.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

pve-qm-scsi.note: Composite: drivedesc_base + iothread + product + queues + readonly + scsiblock + ssd + vendor + wwn
pve-qm-scsi.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

pve-qm-sata.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

pve-qm-virtio.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

pve-qm-efidisk.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

pve-qm-bootdisk.accepts: Valid QEMU drive name (ide0-3, scsi0-30, sata0-5, virtio0-15)

pve-qm-image-format.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

cputype.description: CPU model name — validated against built-in and custom models

pve-vm-cpu-conf.note: cputype validated against known CPU model list; 'reported-model' property forbidden

pve-qm-cpu-arch.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

pve-qm-rng.note: RNG device configuration — see QemuServer.pm for full properties
pve-qm-rng.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

IPorCIDR.accepts: IPv4 or IPv6 address, optionally with CIDR prefix. Validated via Net::IP->new()
IPorCIDR.description: IP address or CIDR (validated by Net::IP)

IPorCIDRorAlias.description: IP/CIDR or firewall alias name (optionally prefixed with dc/ or guest/)

pve-fw-addr-spec.accepts: +ipsetname, aliases (dc/name, guest/name, bare name), or comma-separated IP/CIDR list. No mixed IPv4/IPv6.

pve-fw-sport-spec.accepts: Port numbers 0-65535, ranges N:M, service names from /etc/services, comma-separated (max 15 numeric entries)

pve-fw-dport-spec.accepts: Same as sport-spec plus ICMP type names

pve-fw-icmp-type-spec.note: Full lists have ~32 ICMPv4 and ~24 ICMPv6 types — see Firewall.pm $icmp_type_names and $icmpv6_type_names

pve-fw-loglevel.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

ipset-name.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

pve-fw-alias.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

pve-security-group-name.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()

pve-command-batch.accepts: JSON-encoded array of {path, method (GET|POST|PUT|DELETE), args?} objects

pve-lxc-mp-string.description: LXC mount point path (rejects directory traversal)

pve-lxc-dev-string.description: LXC device path (must start with /dev/, no traversal)

lxc-ip-with-ll-iface.accepts: IPv6 link-local with interface (fe80:addr%iface) or any valid IP
lxc-ip-with-ll-iface.pattern_note: ^(fe80:[^%]+)%(.*)$ for link-local, otherwise delegates to ip format
lxc-ip-with-ll-iface.description: IP address, optionally IPv6 link-local with interface identifier

pve-ct-timezone.description: Container timezone: 'host' or valid IANA timezone

pve-ha-resource-id.description: HA resource ID (type:name, e.g. vm:100, ct:101)

pve-ha-resource-or-vm-id.description: HA resource ID or bare numeric VM/CT ID

pve-ha-node.description: Cluster node name with optional port suffix

pve-sdn-subnet-id.accepts: CIDR notation (contains /) or zone-ip-mask hyphen format converted to ip/mask

pve-sdn-dhcp-range.constraint: start <= end, both within subnet CIDR, no overlapping ranges

backup-fleecing.constraint: storage required when enabled is set

pve-calendar-event.accepts: Systemd-style calendar event specification (parsed by Rust-backed CalendarEvent)

pve-poolid.description: Resource pool ID (supports hierarchical pools with /)

pve-acme-alias.description: DNS alias for ACME verification (allows underscore-prefixed labels)

pem-certificate-chain.accepts: One or more concatenated PEM certificate blocks

pve-storage-path-in-property-string.note: Not found as a registered format in any Proxmox repo. May be constructed dynamically or an alias for pve-storage-path
pve-storage-path-in-property-string.description: Storage path within a property string context
pve-storage-path-in-property-string.history_note: manually estimated — not registered via register_format()
